about: Generated by `pnpm connectors:list` from each connector's definition; edit nothing here. `types` lists every type the connector can write under any of its settings, not only the types it writes by default: a type that a setting adds, such as `rss.picture` for RSS when `RSS_PICTURES` is `save` or `save-in-library`, is included. `carriesBack` is true when, in the connector's default mode, with every optional setting unset, it carries changes made in Marfa back to the vendor: it has an `onChange`, and `carries` (or, where it names none, every type) lists at least one type. `carriesBackCanBeTurnedOff` is true when a setting or mode switches that off, found by setting each optional setting to `true` in turn and asking `carries` again: GitHub with a personal token or `GITHUB_READ_ONLY`, Todoist with `TODOIST_READ_ONLY` and Readwise Reader with `READWISE_READER_INBOUND_ONLY` are the connectors that have one. So `carriesBack` says what a connector does by default, not what one owner's settings leave it doing. A required setting is given a placeholder value when `carries` is asked.

connectors.name: github
connectors.description: Repositories, issues, discussions, comments, read-only pull requests, read-only notifications and read-only Markdown files from chosen repository paths through a personal access token or GitHub App, with relations, closing links and checks. Personal token runs are read only; App runs can carry issue, discussion and comment edits back.

connectors.name: google-calendar
connectors.description: Calendars and events of a Google account, read through the Calendar API, with changes to events made in Marfa carried back.

connectors.name: readwise
connectors.description: Sources and complete highlights from one Readwise account, read only.

connectors.name: readwise-reader
connectors.description: Reader documents, highlights, annotations, and retained content with supported two-way edits.

connectors.name: rss
connectors.description: Entries from Atom, RSS and JSON feeds.

connectors.name: todoist
connectors.description: Tasks from a Todoist account, read through the Sync API, and every todoist.task in Marfa carried back to it.
